aiResearchSummary.text: ServiceTitan is researching systems and methods for digital catalog management, analyzing service job metrics to generate job allocations, and using machine learning for service metric prediction. Efforts also include dynamic pricing, automated generation of service item recommendations, adjustable work-flow capacity planning, and automated customer review matching. These areas reflect a focus on optimizing scheduling, pricing, resource allocation, and customer engagement in home service operations.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series H round raised $365,000,000, or 24.92% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $100,000,000 to $9,500,000,000, a 95x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
